transactions.desc: The Rockies optioned Ritter to Triple-A Albuquerque on Monday.
The Rockies activated Karros (concussion) from the 7-day injured list Monday.
The Brewers recalled Sproat from Triple-A Nashville on Monday, Adam McCalvy of MLB.com reports.
The Mets optioned Hagenman to Triple-A Syracuse on Monday.
The Mets recalled Tong from Triple-A Syracuse on Monday.
The Twins optioned Acton to Triple-A St. Paul on Monday.
The Twins activated Ryan (glute) from the 15-day injured list Monday.
The Yankees optioned Rodriguez to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre following Sunday's game.
The Dodgers recalled Alfonzo from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Sunday.
The Astros optioned Meyers to Triple-A Sugar Land on Sunday.
The Astros claimed Barrosa off waivers from the Diamondbacks on Sunday.
The Mariners optioned Wisdom to Triple-A Tacoma on Sunday.
The Cardinals optioned Rincon to Triple-A Memphis on Sunday.
The Diamondbacks recalled Del Castillo from Triple-A Reno on Sunday.
The Mariners selected Arroyo's contract from Triple-A Tacoma, and he'll start at second base and bat eighth Sunday against the Athletics.

The Cardinals recalled Hjerpe from Triple-A Memphis, and he's expected to pitch behind starter Kyle Leahy in Sunday's game against the Rockies at Coors Field, Jeff Jones of the Belleville News-Democrat reports.
The Diamondbacks designated Kepler for assignment Sunday.
The Orioles recalled Nunez from Triple-A Norfolk on Sunday.
The White Sox recalled Quero from Triple-A Charlotte on Sunday.
The Astros recalled Ullola from Triple-A Sugar Land on Sunday.
The Astros optioned Teng to Triple-A Sugar Land on Saturday.
Detroit optioned Sears to Triple-A Toledo on Sunday.
Detroit reinstated Hurter (back) from the 60-day injured list Sunday, Jason Beck of MLB.com reports.
The Orioles designated Suarez for assignment Sunday.
The Mets optioned Yan to Triple-A Syracuse on Sunday.
Baltimore recalled Hinds from Triple-A Norfolk on Sunday.
The Mets recalled Myers from Triple-A Syracuse on Sunday.
The Pirates optioned Yorke to Triple-A Indianapolis on Sunday.
Boston recalled Eaton from Triple-A Worcester on Sunday, Jen McCaffrey of The Athletic reports.
The Pirates recalled Simon from Triple-A Indianapolis on Sunday.
